description: 29 statistical relations for quantitative claim grounding in Knowledge Graphs (pruned from original 46 based on empirical coverage analysis)
pruning_note: 17 relations dropped: 6 had zero triples in preliminary extraction (925 topics, 18K triples), 11 had <15 triples or were redundant with higher-coverage relations. See paper_journey.md for full rationale.

relations.name: HasNumericValue
relations.description: A specific numeric measurement or quantity

relations.name: HasPercentileValue
relations.description: A percentage-based measurement or proportion

relations.name: HasContext
relations.description: The situational/temporal context of a statistic

relations.name: HasStatistic
relations.description: A general statistical value associated with the entity

relations.name: PercentageOf
relations.description: A proportion or share of a total

relations.name: HasMaxValue
relations.description: A maximum threshold or upper bound

relations.name: HasMinValue
relations.description: A minimum threshold or lower bound

relations.name: HasCapacity
relations.description: An installed or planned capacity

relations.name: HasImpact
relations.description: A quantified or described impact/effect (absorbs former ImpactOf relation)

relations.name: HasComparison
relations.description: A comparative quantitative relationship

relations.name: HasGrowthRate
relations.description: A growth or change rate over time

relations.name: Reduces
relations.description: A quantified reduction effect

relations.name: HasPolicyTarget
relations.description: A specific policy goal with deadline

relations.name: Increases
relations.description: A quantified increase

relations.name: HasAverageValue
relations.description: A mean or average measurement

relations.name: HasTrend
relations.description: A directional change over time (growth, decline, etc.)

relations.name: Decreases
relations.description: A quantified decrease

relations.name: Saves
relations.description: A quantified saving (resources, cost, time)

relations.name: VolumeOf
relations.description: A volumetric or quantity measurement
example: Volume of Water Used in Agriculture

relations.name: EmissionOf
relations.description: An emission quantity associated with a source

relations.name: HasAction
relations.description: An action/policy with quantitative implications

relations.name: ConsumptionOf
relations.description: A consumption quantity

relations.name: HasUnitOfMeasurement
relations.description: The measurement unit for a quantitative property

relations.name: EfficiencyOf
relations.description: An efficiency metric or rating

relations.name: RateOf
relations.description: A rate measurement (per unit time, per capita, etc.)

relations.name: PolicyOf
relations.description: A policy target or mandate with numbers

relations.name: HasSource
relations.description: The authoritative source of the statistical claim

relations.name: MitigationOf
relations.description: A mitigation target or achievement

relations.name: RiskOf
relations.description: A quantified risk or probability
example: 2x increase in extreme weather events by 2050
